name: Gearbox
text:
Decision: Add a **real-time terrain classification model** to EXCAVA’s toolkit.

Why: Modern vision models (like lightweight ViT or ConvNeXt) can spot subtle soil differences—rock vs. clay vs. root mass—faster than human operators or legacy sensors. That tiny edge in accuracy cuts cycle time by ~0.5% by reducing false digs and rework. The trade-off? We accept a ~10% increase in compute load per pass, but the model runs on the onboard GPU we already have—no new hardware needed.
